facts.fact: Built as Progress Downs (1966-68), redesigned and renamed RedTail in 1999 for the red-tailed hawks that nest in the trees round the course.
The developer asked for a fox (2026-10-22).

current.subject: A red fox sitting in profile, tail curled.
current.keep: The fox's colour and white-tipped tail.
current.weaknesses: A full-body animal scene; the face is small at 1x.

concepts.name: The Fox Mask
concepts.rationale: The fox's face alone: tall black-tipped ears, white cheeks, amber eyes, a pointed muzzle. Geometric and bold.
concepts.strengths: Reads instantly at any size; great on hats.
concepts.tradeoffs: Fox masks are a popular modern motif.

concepts.name: The Namesake
concepts.rationale: A red-tailed hawk seen from below as it soars: pale underwings, dark bars, the brick-red fanned tail.
concepts.symbolism: The bird the course is named after, overhead.
concepts.tradeoffs: Soaring raptors are common in sports logos.

recommendation: Concept 1. The fox mask is the strongest icon in the Portland set; the hawk is the truthful alternative if the name should lead.

options.name: The Medallion
options.idea: The hawk's head in profile on a disc in the tail's own colours: rufous, the narrow dark band, the pale tip.
options.strength: A bold portrait that reads at 1x; the colours alone say 'red tail'.
options.tradeoff: A head on a disc is a common sports-badge form.

options.name: On the Post
options.idea: Perched on a fence post, head turned, the red tail hanging over the wood: the way most people see a red-tail, by a road or a fairway.
options.strength: The most natural pose, and the red tail is plain to see.
options.tradeoff: Tall and narrow; the post takes some of the space.

options.name: Overhead
options.idea: Soaring and banking in a roundel of sky, tail fanned: the view from the fairway when one circles over.
options.strength: Calm, open, and the sky disc frames it on any card.
options.tradeoff: Closest to the soaring hawk you passed on; small head at 1x.

options.name: The Tail Feather
options.idea: One rufous tail feather with its dark band and pale tip: the name, reduced to a single object.
options.strength: Elegant and unusual; great on a hat or ball marker.

options.name: Talons Out
options.idea: Wings flung up, talons forward, coming down on its target.
options.strength: The most energy of the five.
options.tradeoff: The busiest at 1x; close to heraldic eagle poses.

options_note: You chose Talons Out (25 October); it is now the logo in the game.
options_intro: The course was renamed in 1999 for the red-tailed hawks that nest in the trees around it.
